# ADR-3250: AWS security_groups: Unrestricted egress 0.0.0.0/0 for sensitive tier 2

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Open egress enables exfiltration and SSRF impact.

## Decision

Sensitive tiers SHALL NOT allow unrestricted egress 0.0.0.0/0 for sensitive tier 2 (AWS-security_groups-2).

## Consequences

Egress is allow-listed by destination.
